game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones, standing whisper stones: the scholar mage must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Index Archery: Hit targets by choosing the right list index, including negative ones.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones: standing whisper stones
core_gameplay_loop: In Whisper Stones, repeat each round: Hit targets by choosing the right list index, including negative ones. Each round, vine horrors strike the crypt seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the arrows value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the crypt seal from vine horrors in Whisper Stones: keep the arrows meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: arrows drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 2 (intro tier): Index Archery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Index Archery' (Week 7 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Whisper Stones'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how arrows changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Whisper Stones.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while arrows > 0.
